resources.string: It takes a minute. After that, Scam Check quietly checks your texts in the background.
Jev checks incoming texts in the background and warns you if one looks like a scam. You can close this app; it keeps working.
Texts with links, contact details, requests or money words are checked in the background. If one looks risky you get a warning. Nothing is deleted or blocked.
Scam Check needs permission to read incoming texts to protect you. Tap Start protection to try again.
Jev will keep an eye on your texts from now on and warn you if one looks like a scam.\n\nScam Check will close now. It keeps working in the background.
Texts are being checked, but notifications are turned off, so you won\'t see warnings. Allow notifications for Scam Check in your phone\'s Settings.
Paste a text or email you\'re not sure about, or share it to Scam Check from any app.
Links, codes, phone numbers and email addresses are hidden before a message is sent to Jev. Link checks run on this phone.
